lesson.subtitle: Lesson 17 -- What Did They Ask?
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Renato | Lesson 17 -- What Did They Ask?

listenings.text: Right, this will take ten minutes and there are no wrong answers, so relax. Where are you from, and how long have you been surfing? Good. Do you have your own board, or do you need us to lend you one? And a wetsuit, do you have one for winter? Winter here is colder than people expect. Now the medical part. Can you swim four hundred metres without stopping? Yes? Good, because that is a requirement and I have to tick the box. Who is your emergency contact and do you know the phone number by heart? Last thing: will your host family sign the form? The deadline is Friday and we confirm places by email on Monday.

I have sat in on about two hundred of those interviews and I will tell you what they are really checking. They asked you where you were from, but they did not care about the country, they wanted to hear you speak for thirty seconds. They asked if you had your own board because that tells them how serious you are. They asked whether you could swim four hundred metres because insurance says they have to ask. And the question about the emergency contact is the only one where the answer actually matters. If you did not know the number by heart, they wrote that down.
